$comment: ADAAAA-7765 - frame-derived ground truth for a rights-cleared basketball broadcast clip. Labels were read from the pixels only: the broadcast score overlays score digits were read at native frames, and the scoring instant is the first frame whose digits show the new score. No label comes from decide reason text, a detection model, or a soccer clip. Non-event windows lie strictly inside a score-stable interval and were liveness-checked at 320 px frames.

video.rights_holder: TBF (Turkish Basketball Federation) - uploader/author on Wikimedia Commons
video.attribution: TBF, Merkezefendi Belediyesi Denizli Basket - Samsunspor (24.01.2020), CC BY 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons

segment.note: one continuous 850 s segment of source 1100-1950 s: Q1 play through the Q1/Q2 break and into Q2 (period flag 1.C until clip ~660 s, 2.C after); no cut, no replay; the committed clip-root copy is this segment, frame-accurate re-encode
segment.container: mp4 (h264 + aac), frame-accurate re-encode of source 1100-1950 s

video.frame_source: native 1280x720 frames decoded at 1 fps with ffmpeg; score-overlay crops read at native resolution
video.label_method: score-digit catalogue: 1 fps digit-band crops (x 610-752, y 644-674) classified by template match against 16 vision-read score states, plus liveness frames for each non-event window; the instant is the first 1 fps frame showing the new digits
video.confidence_note: The scoring instant is bounded to +-1 s by the 1 fps frame grid (the first frame showing the new digits). A score delta of 1 is a free throw, 2 a field goal, 3 a three-pointer; the delta is the digit difference, not a shot-type label.
video.frames_dir: evals/basketball_val/frames/README.md (reproduction recipe; clip is a box-side clip-root artifact)

label_revisions.note: initial catalogue (14 events) - instants placed at the last frame of the scored state rather than the first frame showing it, and the final event (20-20 -> 22-20 at clip 808 s) was missed

corrected after QA re-read (ADAAAA-7770): transitions re-derived by 1 fps digit-band template matching against the 16 vision-read score states; 15 events, instants are the first frame showing the new digits; non-event window score strings re-derived from the state intervals; audio labels regenerated and the harness re-run

coverage.clip_span_note: 850 s (14 min 10 s) of one continuous feed: the last ~660 s of Q1 play and the first ~190 s of Q2 play (period flag 1.C at clip <=660 s, 2.C from clip ~661 s), above the >= 5 min floor
coverage.floor: >= 5 min clip, >= 8 verified scoring events, >= 10 verified non-event windows
coverage.floor_met: yes for scoring events (15 >= 8) and non-event windows (13 >= 10) on one rights-cleared clip; still one clip only
coverage.detection_slice: none - this manifest labels scoring events and windows, not detection-class boxes (see reference.detectionSlice in services/perceive/app/game_profile.py)
coverage.liveness_note: Each non-event window was liveness-checked and is scored as 'no score' from the score-digit state across the interval (the state interval that contains the window, recorded in the window's score field). 7 are live play (the fair hard-negative set for the audio trigger FP rate) and 6 are dead-ball stoppages. No non-event window contains a scoring transition.
